name.value: InstantClone Open InstantClone in a new tab Free, open source (GPL-3.0) local RTMP delay proxy for OBS on Windows and Linux that lets streamers add, change or cut the stream delay live without restarting the stream, with a scheduled "cut after this airs". It also multistreams to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and custom RTMP (including a vertical 9:16 feed and per-destination audio tracks for VOD-safe music), passes Twitch Enhanced Broadcasting through, keeps every destination live on a reconnect screen if OBS crashes, and adds an OBS dock, overlays, global hotkeys, MIDI control and Twitch, Discord and smart-light integrations. RTMP OBS STREAM-DELAY LIVE-STREAMING TWITCH RUST OPEN-SOURCE INTEGRATIONS ANTI STREAM-SNIPE

name.value: PPPlayer Open PPPlayer in a new tab PPPlayer is a free, open-source, cross-platform music and video player built with Flutter. It brings local media, YouTube playback, internet radio, and network streams together in one modern, easy-to-use application. Designed for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, PPPlayer supports multiple audio and video formats, playlists, playback queues, background playback, and customizable media controls. Its goal is to provide a powerful, lightweight, and completely free alternative to traditional media players, with no subscriptions and a community-driven development approach. MUSIC PLAYER VIDEO PLAYER OPEN SOURCE FLUTTER MEDIA PLAYER YOUTUBE INTERNET RADIO CROSS-PLATFORM DESKTOP

name.value: ChatGPT Image — browser-based AI image and video creation Open ChatGPT Image — browser-based AI image and video creation in a new tab ChatGPT Image is a browser-based creative workspace with text-to-video and image-to-video generation alongside AI image creation and reference-photo editing. Creators can turn a written scene idea or an uploaded image into a video, and explore supporting still visuals such as story concepts, posters and social graphics in the same workspace. Available model choices and controls vary by generation mode. This is a hosted commercial web application, not an open-source library, codec or video-delivery API. name.value: PPPlayer is a free, open-source, cross-platform music and video player built with Flutter. It brings local media, YouTube playback, internet radio, and network streams together in one modern, easy-to-use application. Designed for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, PPPlayer supports multiple audio and video formats, playlists, playback queues, background playback, and customizable media controls. Its goal is to provide a powerful, lightweight, and completely free alternative to traditional media players, with no subscriptions and a community-driven development approach.
